Name: Older Olivia Mod
Author: Chumpersonable
Description:
A mod for SVE that changes the portraits for Olivia to look more age-appropriate. Sure, there's no number attached to her (or, anyone for that matter), but she's old enough to have an adult son.

I'm dating a woman in her 40s. I know what I'm here for.

The mod adds smile lines and small wrinkles under the eyes for all of Olivia's base portraits, plus the ones for Ginger Island.



Currently only works with the base SVE mod, I haven't edited the sprites for the seasonal outfits mod yet. Likely will soon, though.

To install, find where your copy of Stardew is installed on your computer and open the folder for Olivia's portraits (﻿Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\Portraits\Olivia). Unzip the mod folder and replace the files "Olivia" and "Olivia_Beach" that already exist in the SVE folder with the ones from this mod.

Updated to include her winter outfit for 1.6!
